title: my first gameplay !
author: Remote-History-6458
selftext:
hello guys , a week have pass since that beautyfull image created with chatgpt ,that post did amazing almost 100k views ,lots of tips advise some hate obviously and here we are now a week later..  
i did a complete overhaul of the game engine during the matches , now its a 2.5d version and i love how is coming together , just the fact that i arrived till here made me incredible happy , this is my first attempt , i never builded a videogame and before year ago i didnt even knew what coding was  
lots of people have accuse me to show only image cause i dont have a game.. so here goes nothing  
torunament mode  
master league mode ( with multiple season and player market )  
story mode ( in progress )  
quick match with multiple team selectionable ( nationals and club) 

i hope everyone understand that this are almost all placeholder i will not obviously release the gaem with real names and logo or brand 

enjoy the view and let me know your opinion!

comments.author: TaylorCooper337
comments.body: This is 90% menus. You want to make your videos start with the actual gameplay. Congrats on making a game.

comments.author: Sky782a
comments.body: Really nice, it could be more fun to me if the card was directly in game scène and not opening the menu everytime

replies.author: FUJIISAWA
replies.body: Totally agree. Pause the action and do the selections over it. It's too jarring having everything disappear and reappear and it takes you out of the experience. I think the concept is interesting tho.

comments.author: HaikalBaiqunni
comments.body: Nice bro...

comments.author: darktaco
comments.body: Nice to see somebody finally start with designing the menu screens and not the game itself. Too many people get focused on the actual game, and not the menu screens where players actually spend the most time!

replies.author: Fat_Curt
replies.body: Honestly, I was thinking the total opposite - there's a lot of pretty menus but hardly any actual gameplay, which is the bit where the actual fun is had.

replies.author: TaylorCooper337
replies.body: The only reason this makes sense is because most sport sims are living in the menu and popping into matches. Almost 75% can be in menu sometimes people sim entire seasons without playing a game.

comments.author: AdmirableJudgment784
comments.body: I don't like it, because a sports game, which is fast pace, is integrated with a card game, which is slow pace. You have to choose one or the other. If it's a medium pace game like an adventure game that has card integration mini games, then that's fine. But this looks unplayable.

replies.author: Remote-History-6458
replies.body: have you ever played captain tsubasa dream team ? it has 10 mln download, and its exaclty like this turn based actually the action is even less in that

replies.author: TaylorCooper337
replies.body: OP just don’t have the menu come up with the card mechanic, have it pop up as an overlay over the player so it doesn’t break continuity in the match.

comments.author: Laicbeias
comments.body:
what you see here is "trained on the whole web and animes" vs most game dev companies have their code bases private.

i dont mean it as critique it looks amazing. just focus on the gameplay loop and see what soccer games are out there. the hard part will be getting that loop right. in my opinion those "skills" should be time based, with a time freeze on press. basically you have to hit em quickly during gameplay. with some nice effects. and a proper behaviour tree for each player and a skill set of counters for certain skills. (i mean a menu based thing is also fine, but it looks just so cool, that basically ppl be like where is the anime backflip super smash goal shot, with the anime super smash block from the keeper, that drains his endurance)

im not a soccer video player though, but like the ball physic and all that need a lot of iteration. its when the AI approach often slows down a lot

comments.author: BoltVnderhuge
comments.body:
Your UI taste is incredible! Beautiful, original, and functional. Would love to hear if you had particular resources/inspirations. 

You might consider adding a strict timer (<10 seconds) to the play decisions. This would increase the speed, raise the the stakes, and allow for more skill development to assess the field and options.

replies.author: Remote-History-6458
replies.body: Thanks buddy! Yeah the duel as 30 sec timer, I did 30 sec for now is in dev mode so I can check everything during duel is working but I think I will bring to 15/10

comments.author: HuaHero
comments.body:
Very nice! Congrats on your official first gameplay and its AI that let people like us try out new things, even if our own little projects fails or does not make any money but we all learning new things everyday!

As for the game itself, i think it looks cool and i think you can take a look at football manager on why its so popular because that itself is also mostly menus but its the management part that captures players attention, not sure if its possible to add management into your game with cards feature which you are showing here. I think clubs will expand your game more compared to just international teams.

replies.body: There are already club in the game, as for the management part in the master league mode you can ofc Sim everything so I guess that cover it
